test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

A large number of people are using internet banking these days.

options.text: Internet banking is using a large number of people these days.
Internet banking has been used by a large number of people these days.
Internet banking is being used by a large number of people these days.
Internet banking is used by a large number of people these days.

solution:
The correct answer is- 'Internet banking is being used by a large number of people these days.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the present continuous tense.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion is

 
 
• *subject + is/am/are + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He is doing the work. *(**active**)
 
• *The work is being done by him. *(passive)
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in present tense while converting from **active **to **passive **voice:

 
 
• Simple present - *subject + is/am/are + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football is played by him.*
 
 
 
• Present continuous - *subject + is/am/are + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car is being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Present perfect - *subject + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car has been driven by him.​​​*
